claims.text: Pada 20 Juli 1969, modul pendarat Apollo 11 bernama Eagle berhasil mendarat di permukaan Bulan.

sources.title: Apollo 11
sources.quote: After a three-day transit, Armstrong and Aldrin descended to the surface aboard the LM Eagle, landing in the Sea of Tranquility (Mare Tranquillitatis) on July 20 at 20:17 UTC while Collins remained in lunar orbit aboard the CM Columbia.

claims.text: Neil Armstrong dan Buzz Aldrin menjadi dua manusia pertama yang menginjakkan kaki di permukaan Bulan.

sources.title: Apollo 11
sources.quote: Apollo 11 (July 16–24, 1969) was the American spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon, and the fifth crewed mission of NASA's Apollo program.

claims.text: Misi ini dipimpin oleh komandan Neil Armstrong yang mengucapkan kalimat ikonik 'Satu langkah kecil bagi manusia, satu lompatan raksasa bagi umat manusia'.

sources.title: Apollo 11
sources.quote: Stepping onto the lunar surface, Armstrong declared: "That's one small step for [a] man, one giant leap for mankind."

claims.text: Kejadian bersejarah ini disaksikan oleh sekitar 600 juta penonton televisi di seluruh dunia.

sources.title: Apollo 11
sources.quote: Armstrong's moonwalk was broadcast live to an estimated 600 million viewers, roughly one-fifth of the world's population, making it among the most-watched television events in history.

claims.text: Pada tanggal 20 Juli 1969, astronaut Neil Armstrong dan Buzz Aldrin menerbangkan modul pendarat Eagle ke Bulan.

sources.title: Lunar Module Eagle
sources.quote: It was flown to the Moon on July 20, 1969, by astronaut Neil Armstrong with navigational assistance from Buzz Aldrin.

claims.text: Modul Eagle mendarat di Base Tranquillity pada pukul 20:17:40 UTC tanggal 20 Juli 1969.

sources.title: Lunar Module Eagle
sources.quote: Eagle was landed at Tranquility Base at 20:17:40 UTC on July 20, 1969, with 216 pounds (98 kg) of usable fuel remaining.

claims.text: Mare Tranquillitatis menjadi lokasi pendaratan berawak pertama di Bulan pada tanggal 20 Juli 1969.

sources.title: Mare Tranquillitatis
sources.quote: Mare Tranquillitatis was the landing site for the first crewed landing on the Moon on July 20, 1969, at 20:18 UTC.

claims.text: Setelah pendaratan modul Eagle, Neil Armstrong menyampaikan kalimat 'The Eagle has landed' kepada pengendali penerbangan di Bumi.

sources.title: Mare Tranquillitatis
sources.quote: After astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin made a soft landing in the Apollo 11 Lunar Module Eagle, Armstrong told flight controllers on Earth, "Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed."
